review.notes:
No sign-in is needed. The app has no accounts, no in-app purchases, no advertising and no analytics.

Cowdrey One lists Bradley Cowdrey's own free apps (Cowdrey.PDF, Cowdrey.MD, Meridian, Two Degrees, Bearings and Golden Hour) and helps people get them. Tapping Get on an app opens that app's App Store page inside Cowdrey One (SKStoreProductViewController); Get All opens each one in turn. Apps that are only on the web open in Safari.

How to try it:
1. Launch the app and tap Continue on the welcome screen.
2. On Discover, tap any app to see its page, or tap Get to open its App Store page.
3. Tap Get All on the set-up card to step through every app on the App Store.
4. Library shows the apps Cowdrey One can tell are on this device (on iPhone and iPad, only apps whose link opens, such as Two Degrees; iOS doesn't let it see the rest) and lists the others with Get. Tapping Get doesn't mark an app as got. Share shows a QR code for Cowdrey One, which opens its web version (with no downloads).

On the Mac (the Mac App Store version): Get on an app that is on the Mac App Store (Two Degrees) opens that app's Mac App Store page in the App Store app. Get on an app that isn't on the Mac App Store yet opens its web version in the default browser. Cowdrey One looks in /Applications (and ~/Applications) for the apps it lists, only to show Open for one that is already there (Open launches it). It downloads nothing, installs nothing and updates nothing: it has no installer, no update check of its own and no downloads of .dmg or other files. There are no accounts, no sign-in and no purchases on the Mac either.

How to try it on the Mac:
1. Launch the app and click Continue.
2. Click Get on Two Degrees: the Mac App Store opens its page.
3. Click Open on any other app (marked On the web): its web version opens in the browser.
4. Library lists the apps found in Applications with Open, and the rest with Get (or Open, for the web).

Network use: the app reads GitHub's public releases API (api.github.com) to show each app's latest version and release notes. Nothing about the person is sent anywhere; which of the listed apps Cowdrey One has seen on the device is kept on the device only. The interface is in English and works the same in all regions.
